purpose: Pinned, verifiable source of truth for the official MATLAB MCP server binary. No download or local binary may be treated as trusted unless its SHA-256 matches an entry here.

upstream.digestSource: GitHub Release API asset.digest (sha256) queried 2026-10-21 via `gh api repos/matlab/matlab-mcp-server/releases`; the same digest independently matched the locally downloaded v0.15.0 Windows asset.
upstream.doNotUseLatest: The previous default used releases/latest/download, a moving target that cannot be pinned. It is intentionally not referenced anywhere in this manifest.

failurePolicy: If the manifest is missing, the platform entry is absent, or a hash does not match, the installers must fail closed and print manual installation instructions. An unverified binary may only be used when the operator explicitly passes -AllowUnverifiedServer, and that state must be recorded as UNVERIFIED_ACCEPTED_BY_OPERATOR, never as success.
